facets.bk: Tigrilla from the Tome of Horrors Complete

body:
This creature looks like a gorilla with the head of a tiger. Its arms end in sharpened claws and its fur is orange–brown. Its head is striped like that of a normal tiger.

Tigrilla
CR 5

XP 1,600
N Large magical beast
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (–2 Dex, +3 natural, –1 size)
hp 30 (4d10+8)
Fort +8; Ref +6; Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 35 ft., climb 15 ft.
Melee 2 claws +8 (1d8+4 plus grab), bite +7 (2d6+4 plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks pounce, rake (2 claws +10, 1d8+4)

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 15, Con 15, Int 5, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +9 (+13 grapple); CMD 21 (25 vs. trip)
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception) B, Weapon Focus (claw)B
Skills Acrobatics +10, Climb +12, Perception +8, Stealth +6 (+10 in tall grass), Swim +8; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Stealth (+8 in tall grass)

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

A tigrilla attacks by raking with its claws and biting with its fangs. Given the chance, it pounces on an opponent and rips it to shreds with its claws and teeth.
